sources.title: Meiji Jingu — official visit info
sources.claim: Meiji Jingu opens at sunrise; June hours ~5:00–18:30, free admission.

sources.title: Imperial Palace East Gardens — hours
sources.claim: Free; 9:00-18:00 Apr 15-Aug 31; closed Mon and Fri.

sources.title: Tokyo Skytree — hours
sources.claim: Last entry 1 h before close.

sources.title: Senso-ji guide (Matcha)
sources.claim: Main hall 6:00-17:00; grounds 24h; lit till 23:00.

sources.title: Senso-ji — official
sources.claim: Tokyo's oldest temple; ~30M worshippers annually.

sources.title: Shibuya Crossing guide
sources.claim: Shibuya Sky 46F gives best bird's-eye of the Scramble.

sources.title: Imperial Palace guided tours
sources.claim: Free 75-min guided tours twice daily; passport required.

sources.title: Meiji Shrine — Japan Guide
sources.claim: 70-ha forest beside Harajuku; Inner Garden ¥500; Museum ¥1,000.

sources.title: Senso-ji — Japan Guide
sources.claim: 1-2 h; best early AM or after dark.

sources.title: Asakusa guide — GaijinPot
sources.claim: Old Edo; rickshaws; Kappabashi Kitchen Town.

sources.claim: Evening: 70-80% fewer crowds; lit until 23:00.

sources.title: Ginza — Japan Guide
sources.claim: Chuo Dori pedestrian zone Sat/Sun noon-18:00 (Oct-Mar until 17:00).

sources.title: Akihabara — Japan Guide
sources.claim: Chuo Dori pedestrian Sun 13:00-18:00.

sources.title: Shinjuku — Japan Guide
sources.claim: World's busiest station; free 45F TMG observatory.

sources.title: Shinjuku nightlife guide
sources.claim: Golden Gai: 2-3 bars, cash, respect 'regulars only' signs.

sources.title: Harajuku — Japan Guide

sources.title: Roppongi — Japan Guide

sources.claim: Shibuya 'warrants a late start'; peak 3-5 PM; 20-min Cat Street walk to Harajuku.

sources.claim: Daikanyama T-Site (Tsutaya Books) + Meguro River canal walk.

sources.claim: Lantern-lit Meguro River; bars spill onto riverside path in summer.

sources.title: Best Tokyo neighborhoods for foreigners
sources.claim: Roppongi: complicated reputation — touts, scams, overpriced covers.

sources.title: Tsukiji outer market guide
sources.claim: Opens ~5 AM; most stalls close by 14:00; closed Sundays.

sources.title: Tsukiji outer market food guide
sources.claim: Maguroya Kurogin (tuna); Kitsuneya (horumon-ni).

sources.title: Tokyo ramen 2026

sources.claim: Tsuta reopened Feb 2023 in Yoyogi-Uehara (not old Sugamo address).

sources.title: Shinjuku Gyoen — official

sources.title: Rikugien Garden — Japan Guide

sources.claim: ¥300; tidal pond; matcha at Nakajima ¥500-1,000.

sources.title: Kabukiza single-act tickets
sources.claim: Hitomakumi (single-act) tickets; 60-90 min.

sources.title: Edo-Tokyo Open Air Museum

sources.claim: 2026 peak Mar 27-29.

sources.title: Tokyo City View
